before.name: Microsoft Research PhD Fellowship
before.whoFor: 3rd year PhD students in CS, electrical engineering, and applied mathematics (University nominated)
before.deadline: December 16, 2025 at 11:59 PM ET (Annual; unified Microsoft Research Fellowship)
before.amount: Annual stipend by region of institution, including travel funding: $47,000 (US/Canada), $27,000 (Europe), $17,000 (other listed regions); paid as a one-time unrestricted gift to the institution
before.summary: A two-year fellowship program for PhD students in their third year of doctoral studies. Identifies and supports emerging researchers across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America.
eligibility: Must be in 3rd year of PhD program
Nominated by department chair / university
Demonstrated exceptional potential in computing research

Nominated by university leadership
Demonstrated exceptional research trajectory and innovative vision

before.deadline: September 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM EDT (Annual fixed statutory deadline)

eligibility: Tenure-track faculty appointment at a US or Canadian university
PhD awarded within the last 6 years
Nominated by department chair or distinguished senior scholar with 3 external reference letters
